tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gza' bdud kyi gsang sgrub me rlung

'khyil ba bzhugs so/ / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong gza'i yang gsang bla med kyi sgrub pa ni/ dben par gza'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa ni/ stod lha'i lus kyi dbus kyi zhal gsum mthing ga /g.yas zhal gsum dkar ba/ g.yon zhal gsum ljang ba/ steng na bya rog gi dbu dang bcu'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas zhal bzhad/ g.yon zhal rgod/ dbus zhal rngam zhing khro ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan/ g.yon dang po sbrul zhags/ 'og ma gnyis re'i mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ sku lus thams cad spyan stong gzigs/ rin po che'i rgyan can 'jigs su rung ba/ drang srong skem po'i gzugs can bri ba'o/ /de'i phyogs bzhir gdong mo bzhi la/ shar du stag srin zor gdong zor ba bsnams pa/ lhor bam srin dred gdong rgyu zhags bsnams pa*/ nub tu rkong srin ba lang gdong lcags kyu thogs pa/ byang du 'brog srin chu srin gdong ri rab 'degs shing klad la bskor ba/ lus mi la mgo tha dad cing dkar ser dmar ljang rim pa bzhin no/ /de'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad la lha srin sde brgyad la/ shar du lha dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje smug nag ral pa snyigs pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu klu dmar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ljang ser ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rgyal po dkar ser bam dbyug 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu btsan dmar po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dmu ljang ser nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ byang shar du bdud nag po mdung nag 'dzin pa/ de'i shar phyogs su smin drug la sogs pa bdun/ lho nub byang gsum du bdun bdun te nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni sna tshogs mdog can bum pa dang*/ dpal be'u dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ dgra sta dang*/ dbyug to dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ nor bu dang*/ khang bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/

gdugs dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rtse gsum dang*/ ral gri dang*/ gzhong pa dang*/ mda' gzhu dang*/ mdung dang*/ be con dang*/ mar me dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ gri gug dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ thod khrag dang*/ ne'u le dang*/ spos khang dang*/ dung chos dang*/ pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir mi nag 'o dod 'bod pa/ bud med nag mo ral pa snyigs nas dul mo brdul ba/ khyi nag dgra la zug pa/ stag dang spre'u bya/ gzig byi la/ dom dred/ spyang ki dur bya la sogs pa sna tshogs bris pa'i mtha' skor me ri 'bar bar bya'o/ /de nas stegs gru gsum dpangs sor bzhi ngos gsum khru re yod pa la ro sol gyis byugs pa'i dbus su dong gru gsum brus pa'i nang du dgra yi gzugs bag zan nam/ kham sa la byas pa gan rkyal bzhag pa'i steng du gza'i bshos bu dgu bskor gyi rtse la ling ga dang sha khrag gis brgyan par bya'o/ /de'i ngos su sngar gyi dris sku'i zhal 'ong ba byas la dar nag gur dbub cing*/ zur du 'phral gtor zur gsum pa mtheb skyus bskor ba gcig dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma gcig bshams shing*/ gri dang mdung la sogs pa'i spyan gzigs 'byor tshad bsham mo/ /de ni brten thabs so/ /sgrub dus bla rdo bcang ba la rdo pha wang long bu la mtshal gyis tri drug bris pa dar zab kyis gril nas bcing ngo*/ /des ni lus dang grib ma ltar 'ong zhing 'khu ldog mi 'byung ngo*/ / sgrub pa dngos la/ bsnyen pa sgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal mthing nag spyan gsum nyi zla ltar 'bar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser bskal pa'i me stag 'phro zhing*/ nyi zla thod skam gyis brgyan pa phyag g.yas ma'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong klad la bskor zhing*/ g.yon pas sdig mdzub dang phur bu 'dril pa/ zhabs gnyis rkyang bskum du bzhugs shing*/

stag lpags kyi smad g.yogs dang mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa gcig tu bsgoms la/ ba spu'i khung nas sprul pa'i khro chung me yi tsha tsha 'phro bas lha srin sde brgyad sngangs zhing 'dar bar bsams la rig pa ngar bskyed nas/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes de ri ri bzlas par bya'o/ / de nas mdun gyi bris sku de bris pa ltar bskyed la/ 'bod sngags bdun brjod pas gza' rgyu ba'i phyogs nas de 'dra ba byon nas zin pas bsams la/ hrī shag ru raṃ na ge tsi ta traṃ/ ma ma yong za 'gram ha he yo ge sha la dza dza zhes 'bod sngags ci 'grub bzlas nas thun 'jog khar/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma sha khrag gi ri dang rgya mtshor bsams la/ rnga dang dril bu thod gling la sogs pa dkrol zhing gsur chen gyi dud pa btang nas 'di skad do/ /hūṃ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bcas nag po mthu bo che/ / gza' chen sde brgyad rgyu skar btsun mo bcas/ tshur spyon tshur spyaun gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ ho bha ling ta khā hi/ ā+oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la tsa ra ka/ byin nu rā tsa/ bdud po rā dza/ drang srong dkar ser/ khyab 'jug chen po/ du ba mjug ring*/ gdong mo bzhi/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis 'bul lo/ /de nas 'di skad do/ /hūṃ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /pha ni srin la ma ni klu/ /klu srin tshogs pa'i mthu bo che/ /rig 'dzin dgra bla 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di/ / gsol cig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ /'jigs gzugs du ba 'khyil 'dra'i sku/ /dbu dgus sdang mig dgra la gzigs/ /ltas ngan bya rog dgra la sgrogs/ /phyo phyo sdang ba'i dgra la phyo/

/phyo phyo gnod pa'i bgegs la phyo/ / g.yas zhal 'dzum dang ldan pa yis/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ / g.yon zhal rgod cing gshe ba yis/ /dgra bo'i yul du dal yams phob/ / dbus zhal 'jigs su rung ba yis/ /lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdus/ / mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar ba yis/ / rang gi phyogs rnams rgyal bar mdzod/ /klu sbrul zhags pa dbyug pa yis/ / dgra bo'i bla srog khug la sgrol/ /rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs pa yis/ /dgra bgegs dpung rnams rdul du rlogs/ /phyo phyo dgra bo'i yul du phyo/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung phyo/ /dal yams nad kyi bu yug phyo/ /phung byed lhog pa gzer thung phyo/ /dgra bgegs yul du dmag sna drongs/ /dmag dpon khyab 'jug chen pos mdzod/ /srog gcod srin mo bzhi yis mdzod/ /ltas ngan sde brgyad tshogs kyis thong*/ khyab 'jug chen po'i dmag dpung ni/ /rngams pa'i bshug glu di ri ri/ /nad kyi bu yug thu lu lu/ /mtshon gyi char pa si li li/ / dgra bgegs steng du da phyo zhig /gza' chen brgyad po da phyo zhig /rgyu skar nyer brgyad da phyo zhig /gdong mo mched bzhi da phyo zhig /lha srin sde brgyad da phyo zhig /badz+ra king ka ra king ka ra dha sha gh+ri ba/ /yag sha gri ba yaka sha gri ba/ sra'i shag sra'i shag /'ur wa 'ur wa/ thun thun/ srog la bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes brjod nas thal mo brdab pa'i bar du dgra sgong lpags bcar ba bzhin song bar bsam nas/ gtor chung gcig po gshegs so/ /de ni rgyun gyi bsnyen pa ste 'bum phrag gsum byas na 'khu ldog mi 'byung zhing snying nye ba'i las byed do/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ bca' gzhi de dang 'dra khyad par du zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrub bo/ /mtshams dam par gcad nas 'bod sngags kyi gsham du/ ha ha/ tshal pa tshal pa/ zhung zhung*/ nyigs nyigs/ tshe yi srog la mā ra ya rbad rbad/ ces bzlas shing*/

ling ga la dgug gzhug drag po byas te/ dgra'i sha khrag dngos su bsams la gtor ma gtang*/ rbad bskul bya/ gtor chung dgra phyogs su gtang*/ de dus dngos su a tsa ra 'am/ ban de nag po ral pa can gtor ma 'dod du 'ong bas lta bas zin par byas la chang phud gtor zhing dam bsre'o/ /de'ang thod nang gi chang la rang yang btung kho la yang byin nas/ gtan gyi grogs su khyod bsten pas 'go zhing stongs grogs gnyer bo gyis shig bya'o/ / gsum pa las sbyor ni/ sgrub pa thon pa'i dus su maṇ+ḍal steng gi gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phangs shing dmod bcol bstod bskul drag po byas pas dgra la gza'i rims smyau 'bog brgyal nad gzer thung la sogs pas 'chi'o/ /lo thog gzhom par 'dod na yul des sngo phud bsdus te lha rten yod pa'i sar mdze rkang gi sgyed bu gsum tsugs la/ 'og tu dong du tsher ma can gyi shing gtser ba'i steng du mdze thod du/ mdze khrag /gri khrag /mngal khrag / yugs sa'i dor rta/ mi rta khyi dang bong bu'i chu rtag par blugs la/ 'og nas me btang la khol ba dang me nang du kha sbubs pas ser ba dang thog de ma thag 'bab cing*/ gza' yams 'byung ngo*/ /de dus nam mkha' thams cad gza' bdud kyi khengs nas thog ser 'bebs par bsam la/ gtor ma btang nas yul che ge mo 'dis/ khyod la phod du btsugs pas thog dang ser chen phob cig bya'o/ /de nas rang gar phyin du 'bab bo/ gsang ba yang khol gyi gnad 'di kho na'o/ /gza' bdud chen po yang gsang bla na med pa'i sgrub thabs theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ /sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)gza' bdud kyi gsang sgrub me rlung 'khyil ba/ - PAGE 256 - - PAGE 259 -- PAGE 255 -
